candidate.title: MIRA
candidate.scope: The MIRA (methylated-CpG island recovery assay) enrichment schematic in the assigned poster: genomic DNA fragmentation, MBD2B/MBD3L1 binding, glutathione-bead isolation, and DNA purification/PCR to a DNA endpoint. Neighboring RRMAB-seq, TAB-Seq and MeDIP-Seq/DIP-seq rows are outside this card. The sequencing interface is interpreted from the MIRA paper; unshown library-preparation steps and array alternatives are not additional target workflows.

features: The target emblem reads 5mc CpG island; the detailed input DNA shows two 5mC-marked cytosines among C/G symbols.

states.label: Purified, PCR-amplified DNA representing the recovered fraction
features: The depicted endpoint is purified, amplified DNA from the retained affinity fraction, without a specified adapter or end structure.

The readout carrier is genomic DNA sequence: in the paper’s sequencing interface, recovered fragments receive Illumina adapters, fragment ends are read, and their genomic alignments locate methylation-enriched regions. Those downstream operations are outside this graph.
Representation is regional and affinity-dependent. Methylated-CpG density influences capture, low-CpG regions may be under-represented, and recovery does not call every CpG’s methylation state.

evidence.quote: The selectively isolated methylated DNA fraction is amplified, labeled and analyzed on different microarray platforms or with high throughput DNA sequencing on the Illumina Genome Analyzer (Fig. 2, and unpublished data).

In the high throughput sequencing approach (see Figure 2), the MIRA-enriched fractions are amplified in the Illumina cluster station after ligation of adaptors, and the ends are sequenced. Sequence reads are aligned to the genome.
evidence.rationale: This establishes the downstream readout interface without adding unshown adapter ligation, cluster generation, sequencing, or mapping operations to the graph.

evidence.quote: The MIRA technique is based on the high affinity of a two-protein complex formed by methyl-CpG-binding proteins (MBD) 2b and 3L1, which bind to methylated DNA in a methylated CpG density-dependent manner [31]. Regions of fragmented DNA with greater methylated CpG content, such as CpG islands, will have enhanced affinity for the MBD complex, allowing for enrichment of these regions in the final analysis, whereas regions with low CpG content will be under-represented.
evidence.rationale: Full-text MIRA application evidence explains the density-dependent affinity limitation; it does not establish a universal fragment-size or site-count cutoff for the poster.

evidence.quote: MIRA-Seq is not sensitive enough to detect more subtle, but influential, differences in methylation at specific CpG sites.
evidence.rationale: Regional enrichment cannot establish the methylation status of every individual CpG on a recovered fragment.

operations.label: Fractionate
operations.description: Fragment genomic DNA into shorter molecules, yielding a mixed population that includes methylated-CpG-bearing and unmarked DNA fragments. The broken DNA icons resolve the caption Fractionate as fragmentation at this step.
operations.mechanism: DNA fragmentation; the schematic does not specify an instrument or enzyme.
operations.information_effect: Preserves genomic sequence and methylation on individual input fragments before affinity selection.

evidence.rationale: This clarifies the depicted transformation without selecting one of the paper’s fragmentation implementations.

operations.label: MBD2B/MBD3L1 protein complex
operations.description: Add the affinity-binding protein complex to the fragments; the depicted methylated fragment becomes protein-bound while the unmarked fragment remains free.
operations.mechanism: The GST-MBD2B/His-MBD3L1 complex binds preferentially to methylated CpG-containing double-stranded DNA; the paper reports that MBD3L1 has no DNA-binding domain itself and increases affinity through association with MBD2B.
operations.information_effect: Associates methylated DNA fragments with a capture handle; it does not encode methylation through a base conversion.

evidence.locator: MIRA row: MBD2B/MBD3L1 protein complex arrow and proteins attached to the 5mC-bearing fragment

evidence.quote: The MIRA approach works on double-stranded DNA and does not depend on the application of methylation-sensitive restriction enzymes.

In the MIRA procedure, the fragmentized genomic DNA is incubated with purified GST-MBD2B and His-MBD3L1 proteins. The high affinity MBD2B/MBD3L1 complex is formed and binds to the methylated genomic DNA templates.

MBD3L1 is also a member of the MBD family, is a homologue of MBD2 and MBD3, has no DNA binding domain itself, but can be a binding partner of MBD2, via heterodimer formation (10). The MBD2B/MBD3L1 heterodimer has higher affinity to methylated DNA than MBD2B alone (4, 6).

operations.label: Isolate on glutathione-coated beads
operations.description: Retain protein-associated DNA on the glutathione-coated bead support, separating the captured fraction from the faded free DNA fragment.
operations.mechanism: The GST-bearing MBD2B component supplies the affinity interface to the glutathione-coated support, recovering its associated DNA. This is a protein-mediated enrichment, with bead attachment distinct from free DNA.
operations.information_effect: Enriches methylated-CpG-bearing genomic fragments relative to material not captured; no perfect specificity is implied.

evidence.quote: In the high throughput sequencing approach (see Figure 2), the MIRA-enriched fractions are amplified in the Illumina cluster station after ligation of adaptors, and the ends are sequenced. Sequence reads are aligned to the genome.

The MIRA technique is based on the high affinity of a two-protein complex formed by methyl-CpG-binding proteins (MBD) 2b and 3L1, which bind to methylated DNA in a methylated CpG density-dependent manner [31]. Regions of fragmented DNA with greater methylated CpG content, such as CpG islands, will have enhanced affinity for the MBD complex, allowing for enrichment of these regions in the final analysis, whereas regions with low CpG content will be under-represented.
